content: Rabid The Unseen enemy . Stand Alone .  The small bio-tech firm was an investor’s dream, with one public success under  there  belts the company soon sets out to conquer the common cold, putting out what they call a miracle drug, but something happens and within six months of taking the drug , those people began to change,  becoming nothing more  then  aggressive animals , Avery begins to see it and desperately tries to cover it up, while others race to find out how to stop the deadly man-made epidemic.  .  Dr. Robert Avery Rockstar in Biochemical Compounds Dr. Avery founded the small bio-tech firm to help people after the success of his first drug he begins work on something that could finally cure the common cold. He is egotistical and pompous and using a loophole he pushes his drug through using the 510K loophole, taking too many shortcuts .
